correctness.rationale: For 2n signed nodes ±sqrt(n) Ue_j, direct sign pairing gives predicted mean tr(B), exact cross covariance ell and innovation s_U=R+||ell||^2+n sum_j (U^T B U)jj^2-(tr B)^2. Independent direct NumPy node evaluation verified this for random symmetric B and orthogonal U in dimensions 2–5. Gaussian fourth moments give s*=R+||ell||^2+2||B||F^2. The equal-diagonal-basis induction constructs the sharp lower endpoint w, and eigenframes attain upper w+nF-t^2; connected SO(n) supplies every value. The exact affine estimator MSE difference is (s*-s_U)ell ell^T/s_U^2, not a conditional Bayesian posterior. Therefore calibration iff n >= 2+t^2/F, with eigenframe rigidity at equality. Rank-one, traceless and scalar B boundaries are consistent.
